topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I stood there, under the spot where that grand old tree once stood, feeling a deep absence. The tree, a gift from my childhood, had been a steadfast friend, its branches cradling secrets and laughter. Now, only the stump remains, a silent testament to the time that passed. But I am not lost in sorrow; instead, I am filled with gratitude for every moment spent beneath its canopy. Life moves on, and so will I, carrying the memories and lessons it gave me. Perhaps it's time to plant a new tree, one to watch grow as I continue to grow, too.
